newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks remain higher in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks remain higher in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were higher in late Wednesday trade as electronics continued to attract buying despite worries of profit-taking at current prices, brokers said.
With 65 minutes left, at 0255 GMT, the index was up 32.16 points or 0.39 percent at 8,287.94.
Turnover was moderate at T$74 billion.
Electronics led the gains, rising 1.37 percent, despite likely profit-taking after the sector's persistent gains in the past 15-20 sessions, brokers said.
"The question is: it's hard for investors to find other sectors like electronics that have such a sound profit outlook," said Golden Securities research chief Albert lin.
More than half of the market's trading has focussed on electronics in recent sessions, he said.
Leading chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor rose T$2.5 to T$127 on short-squeeze, brokers said. Another top chipmaker, United Microelectronics, rose T$1 to T$79.5.
Acer Peripherals rose the daily seven percent limit to T$72 as it went bonus issue on Wednesday.
Brokers said they expected a firming trend ahead, with the index testing 8,500.
